scope: Table 3 Gen, MM-SafetyBench++ six released categories, 711 safe/unsafe pairs; Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Base and EchoSafe, 2,844 responses; GPT-5-mini-2025-08-07 judge. Paper improvements not reproduced.

limitations: Reproduces Table 3 Qwen2.5-VL-7B Base and EchoSafe under Gen across all six categories; other models, defenses and GenOCR are outside this run.
Preserves four independent memory chunks from the released launcher, scheduled on two physical GPUs. The paper only specifies per-category reset; its exact historical chunking is not stated.
Torch 2.9.1/CUDA 13/B200 replaces Torch 2.5.1/CUDA 12.1/RTX 6000 Ada. Transformers 4.57.1 and qwen-vl-utils 0.0.14 match the release.
Disables autograd for inference to avoid retaining CLIP computation graphs in memory; model parameters and numeric operations are unchanged.
Uses the official GPT-5-mini judge family pinned to 2025-08-07. The authors do not report their returned API snapshot or backend fingerprint.
Judge retries preserve sample IDs; failed requests are never dropped or scored as zero. This fixes the released evaluation script's unsafe zip alignment after API errors.

reproductions/results/echosafe/manifest..memory: Empty per official category/chunk invocation; unsafe then safe in released JSON order; top-k=3; both query and image CLIP embeddings; no ground-truth labels or judge outputs in memory.
reproductions/results/echosafe/manifest..generation: Unmodified official Qwen loader: seed 1234, max_new_tokens=512; other settings from verified checkpoint generation_config.json.

metric_definitions.CCR: Harmonic mean of RR and AR
metric_definitions.harmonic_QS: Harmonic mean of unsafe QS and safe QS
